sn2.5:1.1: Sāvatthiyam ārāme || || Atha kho Dāmali devaputto abhikkantāyā rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Dāmali devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn2.5:2.1: Karaṇīyam ettha brāhmaṇena || padhānam akilāsunā || kāmānaṃ vippahānena || na tenāsiṃsate bhavan ti || ||
sn2.5:3.1: Natthi kiccaṃ brāhmaṇassa || Dāmalīti Bhagavā || katakicco hi brāhmaṇo || || Yāva na gādham labhati || nadīsu āyūhati sabbagattehi jantu || gādhaṃ ca laddhāna thale ṭhito so || nāyūhati pāragato hi so ti || ||
sn2.5:4.1: es-upamā Dāmali brāhmaṇassa || khīṇāsavassa nipakassa jhāyino || pappuyya jāti-maraṇassa antaṃ || nāyūhati pāragato hi so ti || ||
